newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland may annul tender for Pafawag sale-official.
newsitem.headline: Poland may annul tender for Pafawag sale-official.

text.p: The privatisation ministry will annul a tender for the sale of Poland's leading rolling stock maker Pafawag SA if the only bidder does not decide on the purchase by end-August, a ministry official said on Monday.

Adtranz, a joint venture between ABB group and Daimler-Benz AG, has been interested in the privatisation, in which the ministry is offering a 75 percent stake in Pafawag, based in the southern city of Wroclaw.

"The ministry drew a deadline for the firm with which it is negotiating to make a decision. If it does not decide by August 31, the tender will be annulled and a new one announced," Barbara Hajduk of the ministry's press office told Reuters.
She declined to name the firm involved.
Adtranz officials were not immediately available for comment.

Swiss-Swedish group ABB Asea Brown Boveri AG now controls 10 medium-size companies in Poland and has minority stakes in three more. Earlier this year it said would consider further acquisitions in Poland after buying Pafawag.

The privatisation ministry plans to earmark 20 percent of Pafawag shares for its employees and a five percent stake for a government scheme to compensate former owners for property confiscated under communist rule.
